name: stockalert-chrome-extension
description: Detect stock symbols while browsing and create StockAlert.pro alerts from Chrome.

scripts.dist:zip: rm -f stockalert-chrome-extension.zip && npm run build && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete && cd dist && zip -r ../stockalert-chrome-extension.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' '__MACOSX/*' 'icons/README.md'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

author: Adanos Software GmbH
